Commentary.Commentary: 162 is the target for Oman to directly qualify for the 2020 WT20. Can they chase it down? Chasing has always been a bit tricky in this tournament under lights. Stay tuned...

Talking about the Omani bowling which was good for the first 15 overs, Bilal Khan and Fayyaz Butt were the chief destroyers. Bilal finished with a 4-fer, the only bowler escaping punishment while every other bowler got the stick. The last 6 overs yielded 79, while the first 14 went for just 82!

On the wicket, Smit says that the wicket was little tacky early on. On his power, Smit says that he practices a lot to power the ball hard. Adds that the ball was not coming nicely early on but once the ball became old, shot making was easy. Smit says that he is hopeful that the bowlers will execute their plans well and finish on the winning side.��

Actually, it was all Oman for the first 15 overs. They kept Namibia under the cosh, did not give too many balls and kept picking up wickets. They had the African side reduced to 69/5 in the 13th over but then, a counter-attacking stand from Smit and Williams changed the complexion of the game. They added 83 in just 40 balls and all of a sudden, Oman started to get very loose in the field. Smit himself scored 59 from 25, which had 3 fours and 5 sixes. Here he is, talking to Dirk Nannes.
162 to win then for Oman. Have Namibia got enough? The pitch is a good one to bat on, no doubt, but with swing available under lights, this might be a difficult ask for the Omani batsmen.
Two to finsih. Another slower shortish length ball, Frylinck pulls it towards deep mid-wicket and scampers back for the second. NAMIBIA FINISHES WITH 161 RUNS ON THE BOARD.
Full on the pads, Viljoen whips it through mid on for a quick single.
Shortish ball outside off, Frylinck looks to punch off the back foot the ball takes the bottom edge and goes towards cover for a singe.
Slower ball this time and Frylinck swings and misses. Shortish length outside off, Frylinck goes hard but misses.
Shortish length ball around off, pushed towards cover for a single.
FOUR! A length ball around middle, Viljoen looks to push it down the ground but the ball moves away, takes the outside edge and races through the vacant slip region to the third man fence.
Christi Viljoen comes in at number 9, replacing Smit.

OUT! Caught! 2 in 2 for Bilal and he finishes with a 4-fer. A full toss again, outside off, Smit looks to go over the boundary but hits it high in the air. Khurram Nawaz comes running in and takes the catch. End of a magnificent innings from Smit. 59 from just 25 balls, which might just book the ticket to Australia for Oman.
Jan Frylinck comes in to bat now.

OUT! Caught this time. A high full toss, outside off, Williams jumps out and looks to go over the off side but mistimes it. The ball goes high in the air and Khawar Ali at short extra cover completes the formalities. End of an 83-run stand.
Outside off, yorker, Williams looks to dig it out but misses. The ball swings away and the keeper appeals for a catch but he is not entertained.
Around off, swung towards long on for a run.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Around off, worked through the leg side for a single.
Bilal Khan to bowl the 19th over. 3-1-16-2 so far.

Full and outside off, Williams looks to swing hard but gets a thick outside edge. The ball goes between short third man and backward point. One of them gets to the ball and pulls it back in, but was his foot beyond the boundary while picking the ball? The umpire says it is fine. 67 from the last 4 overs!
Comes down the track, takes it on the full and drives it to long off for a run.

SIX! No, not at this stage. Or at any stage. This is a guy in excellent touch. A short ball, around off, Smit goes back and pulls it over long on. Deep mid-wicket and long on get across for the catch but no use. The ball sails over.

SIX! That has gone into the third tier! Half century for JJ Smit, in just 20 balls - THE FASTEST OF THE TOURNAMENT. He has changed the complexion of the game in a matter of 30 minutes. Full and outside off, Smit comes down the track and sends it sailing over long off! To the naked eye, it seemed like a mishit but replays showed otherwise. Raises his bat to the dressing room. Well played, sir.
A long hop, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a single.
Khawar Ali is back on. 2-0-18-0 so far.
FOUR! Clean hitting. Full and outside off, Williams backs away a touch and lofts it over mid off, one bounce and into the fence! 19 from the final over of Nadeem.
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
Around middle, worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! Off the top edge this time. Short and outside off, Smit looks to cut but gets a top edge which flies over the keeper to the third man fence!
SIX! Half century stand in 25 balls! Really taken Oman by storm. A length ball, around middle, Smit whips it over mid-wicket and the ball travels into the stands!
Short and outside off, dabbed to third man for a couple. The throw comes in from the deep to the keeper but he gets a bad bounce and cannot collect. They take the third on the overthrow.
Mohammad Nadeem is back on. 3-0-13-1 so far.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side. 19 from the over, 31 in the last 2!
Around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
SIX! Another massive hit. Full and outside off, Smit reaches out and lofts it over extra cover!
Outside off, punched through the covers for a couple.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Smit looks to cut but gets a bottom edge which goes past short third man!
SIX! Clean hit! Full and around off, Smit reaches out and lofts it over covers, just over the man running to his left at long off!
A yorker around off, dug out back to the bowler.
The batsman does well to leave that bouncer.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a single.
FOUR! Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a boundary!
Outside off, Williams looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge to third man. A single taken.
SIX! AUDACIOUS! A short ball, around off, Williams pulls it over mid-wicket!
Bilal Khan returns. 2-1-4-2 so far.
Full and around off, driven through mid off for a run.
Outside off, Smit punches it through the covers for a single.
Short and outside off, Smit looks to cut but gets a bottom edge which goes on the bounce to the keeper.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a single.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.
On middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for a couple.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Williams rocks back and pulls it towards mid-wicket for a boundary!
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
JJ Smit walks in at number 7, replacing Green.
OUT! Caught! A wicket on the first ball! Short and outside off, Green looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies straight to short third man who makes no mistake.
Aaqib Ilyas into the attack.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Outside off, Green looks to cut but gets a bottom edge to the off side.
Short and outside off, Green looks to cut but hits it uppishly. The fielder leaps but the ball evades him.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
Landed outside off, Green looks to run it down to third man but misses.
SIX! Full and around off, Williams gets down and slogs it over mid-wicket!
The ball has found the edge of the bat. One run added to the total.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Works it through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Full and around middle, Green initially looks to flick but at the last moment, sweeps it through square leg for a single.
A bouncer around off, swayed away from.
Full and outside off, Williams drives it beautifully but straight to the man at short extra cover.
Landed outside off, left alone.

Not far from the fielder! Full and outside off, Williams reaches out and drives it through the covers, a bit uppishly but just wide of the diving fielder. A couple of runs taken as long off mops it up to his right.
Zane Green comes in at number 6, replacing his captain.

OUT! Caught and the captain is gone! Jeez, that is a superb catch by the substitute fielder. Short and outside off, Erasmus upper cuts it towards third man. Initially, it looks like it will clear the ropes. But the substitute fielder, Naseem Khushi, keeps his eyes on the ball and takes the catch. The momentum takes him back but he just about holds himself at the last moment and completes the catch inches before the ropes! Signals towards he dressing room where the support staff is dancing in joy! The captain gone, is a big blow. Can Oman capitalize on it?
Around off, defended watchfully.
Fayyaz Butt into the attack. 1-0-14-0 so far.
Around middle, GE looks to defend but the ball goes off the inner half of the bat towards mid-wicket. A run taken.
Full and around off, Gerhard comes down the track and blocks.
SIX! ADMONISHED! Short and around middle, Erasmus rocks back and pulls it massively over mid-wicket!
Full and around middle, watchfully defended.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Short and around middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Khawar Ali to bowl his leg breaks.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a run.
Short and outside off, Gerhard looks to run it down to third man but is beaten due to extra bounce.
Around off, on a length, worked straight to short mid-wicket.

Short and outside off, Erasmus cuts it behind point. Aamir Kaleem gives it a good chase to his right from third man but while looking to pick the ball up, he fumbles and allows the second. Immediately apologizes to the bowler after releasing the ball.
Full and around middle, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
Landed outside off, played straight to point.
Full and around off, Erasmus looks to play the reverse sweep but gets it off the bottom half towards short third man. A quick single taken.
Short and outside off, cut through point where the fielder dives to his right to make a terrific stop.
Full and around middle, Craig comes down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, short in length, punched straight to cover.
Around middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
Full and around middle, Erasmus gets down and paddles it through fine leg for a couple.
Outside off, Williams punches this uppishly in front of point but the fielder dives to his right and stops it on the bounce. 36/3 in the Powerplay!
In comes the skipper, Gerhard Erasmus, at number 5, replacing Davin.

OUT! Caught! Third wicket in the Powerplay and the top 3 batsmen have been dismissed cheaply. For a change, Namibia are under some early pressure. Full and outside off, Davin looks to swing hard but gets a top edge. Aamir Kaleem comes running hard to his hard and then dives forward to take it inches above the ground. The Oman support staff is thrilled.

Full and outside off, pushed straight to mid off. Davin pushes it towards mid off, takes Zeeshan Maqsood on and sets off for a quick single. Maqsood takes his time and then has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Nikolaas dives in but not sure what would have happened has the throw hit the stumps.
Outside off again, punched wide of mid off for a run.
Outside off, played through point for a quick single.
A length ball around off, pushed towards point.
Fired down the leg side, Davin misses his flick and is hit on the pads, prompting an LBW appeal. Turned down.
Full and around off, pushed down the ground towards long on for a single.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Outside off, the arm ball, Craig looks to punch but gets a bottom edge back to the bowler.
SIX! Classy and glorious. Flighted around off, Williams comes down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and flicks it with the angle over wide long on! Flat hit.
Short and around off, cut straight to cover.
Aamir Kaleem comes into the attack now.
Back of a length around off, tapped towards cover for a quick run.
Full and around off, swinging away, Williams looks to drive it through the covers but is not quite to the pitch of the ball. It hits the inner half of the bat and goes back to the bowler.

Not quite. Nadeem follows the batsman down the leg side, who looks to flick but misses and is hit on the left thigh. The ball rolls to point and a quick leg bye is taken. A mild LBW is put in as well.
Third man comes up while fine leg goes back. Will it be a short ball?
Good comeback by the bowler. Lands it on a length, outside off, Nikolaas backs away and looks to run it down to third man but is defeated by the extra bounce.

SIX! WHOOSH! They are a 6-hitting team, Namibia. 33 sixes now, the most by any tournament in this team. The length is poor, short and barely rises upto Davin's belly button. He quickly swivels and pulls it over square leg!
Full and wide outside off, Davin throws his bat at it but is beaten by the late outswing.
Mohammad Nadeem is into the attack. 6 wickets in the tournament so far for him, at an economy rate of less than 6. These conditions are perfectly suited for fast bowling.
A short ball, around off, CW pulls it but on the bounce to short mid-wicket. A WICKET MAIDEN!
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Around off, Craig goes back and defends it to the off side.
A perfect yorker, around off, but Williams digs it out back to the bowler. Oman are making sure that no new batsman is getting any sighters.
Craig Williams walks in at number 4, replacing Kotze.

OUT! BOWLED! Slower ball and Kotze is foxed. Bilal has his second. The line is nice, around middle and then he gets it to swing away late. Also, he rolls his fingers on the ball, almost like a cutter. JP looks to drive but is way too early into the shot. Misses the timber is hit. Oman have begun well here.
Outside off, punched straight to cover.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a couple. 14 from the over!
FOUR! Uppish, but safe! Davin is going to play his shots. Width on offer, short and outside off, Nikolaas cuts hard, not keeping it down but gets it past point, in front of him.
Steep bounce! Similar ball, to the previous one, Nikolaas looks to push but is comprehensively beaten as the ball lands and then zooms away.

EDGED, FOUR! On a length and outside off, Davin throws his bat at it but the outswing induces an outside edge. However, luckily for him, it flies wide and over first slip, to the third man fence. Mohammad Nadeem rushes to his left from third man and dives but the ball is too quick for him.
FOUR! WHAM! Short and outside off, Davin rocks back and pulls it wide of mid on to the boundary. Gets off the mark in style.
Loose shot. Fractionally short of a length outside off, Davin looks to punch but the ball seams away off the deck and beats him.
Fayyaz Butt to share the new ball with Bilal.
Full and wide outside off, swinging away, JP slashes hard but misses. Excellent opening over.
FOUR! WHACK! First runs on the board. A short ball, around middle and off, Kotze rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket!
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Outside off, pushed straight to point.
Ooohhh... lovely bowling. Full and around middle, swinging away nicely, but Kotze is watchful and defends.
JP Kotze walks in at number 3, replacing Baard.

OUT! Caught! Boy, that is a snorter first up and Baard is sent back for a golden duck. What a nut first up. Swing, seam and bounce. Good luck playing that. A length ball, around middle, Stephan looks to flick but the ball swings in late and then bounces extra off the seam. SB is caught by surprise and looks to fend but the ball takes the glove and lobs to short mid-wicket where Aamir Kaleem comes running in and takes a simple catch. Baard cannot believe it, but he has to go. Big strike for Oman!

The players are out in the middle. Stephen Baard and Nikolaas Davin will open the batting for Namibia. Bilal Khan will start off proceedings with the new ball. Baard to face. A slip in place. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Robert Key looking at the pitch observes that this is the same one which hosted the Netherlands-Oman game. Feels that it is still good for everyone, with the short or back of a length being the key. Ends by saying that batsmen need not go into a shell as this is one of the best pitches in the tournament.

Zeeshan Maqsood, on the other hand, is happy to be bowling first because he feels he knows this pitch well. Agrees that Namibia have a strong batting unit but also believes that Oman need to stick to their own strengths. On being asked whether Namibia have a slight advantage because of their big win here in their last game, Maqsood says that it might be a good thing for them but then this is a crunch game, so everyone will be under pressure. Informs that his team has made one change, with Fayyaz Butt coming in for Kaleemullah.

Namibian captain, Gerhard Erasmus, says that the reason to bat first is because of the formula of putting on scoreboard pressure - bat first and bat big. Believes that the ground is more or less the same from all sides while the pitch is neutral but that does not alter their bowling plans. Feels that if they follow the same processes, they will be privileged to go to Australia. Informs that the players have been doing well for the last 4 games, hence the team is unchanged tonight as well.

Oman (Playing XI) - Jatinder Singh, Khawar Ali, Aqib Ilyas, Aamir Kaleem, Zeeshan Maqsood(c), Suraj Kumar(wk), Sandeep Goud, Khurram Nawaz, Mohammad Nadeem, Fayyaz Butt (IN FOR KALEMULLAH) and Bilal Khan.
Namibia (UNCHANGED Playing XI) - Stephan Baard, Nikolaas Davin, JP Kotze, Craig Williams, Gerhard Erasmus(c), JJ Smit, Zane Green(wk), Christi Viljoen, Jan Frylinck, Bernard Scholtz and Ben Shikongo.
TOSS - Namibia have won the toss and ELECTED TO BAT FIRST.

A warm welcome to the second match of the day and the second match of the Playoffs between Namibia and Oman in Dubai. Earlier in the day, the Dutch progressed to the semis and the 2020 WT20 with a win over the hosts. Who will join them tonight? Namibia come into this win with a thrashing win over Singapore while Oman suffered a loss to Jersey in their final match. Momentum? Or a new day, new winner? Let's hope for a good clash.
